advancements.guhs.guheinde.einde2_h4_vuu: Finish the story of the Guhvatar: from the cheese ball to the coronation
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h4_vuur_aanko: Appa-guh carries the team to the capital of the Fire Nation. Red clothes on, ears under a headband: nobody may know who you are.
In disguise in the Fire Nation
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h4_vuur_agni_: Zuka and Azula-Mika on the palace forecourt. Blue fire against red.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h4_vuur_cel.d: Follow Zuka to his uncle. Miroh says nothing. But he does do push-ups.
Dancing is forbidden in the Fire Nation. In the cave behind the school they do it anyway. Stand on the square that lights up!
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h4_vuur_drake: Dance for the dragon guhs of the Sun Warriors, step by step. Then you learn what fire really is.
Four rounds on the rock pillars, one for each element. And then the rock touches your old scar...
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h4_vuur_eendj: Feed the turtle-duck guhs in the palace pond. They nibble gently. Out of love.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h4_vuur_goedm: Help Zuka find the right words, for Toph-guh and for Katara-guh.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h4_vuur_guhva: The story has been told. You get your own statue, with glowing eyes.
Zuka stands at the edge of the campfire. Nobody trusts him. Toph-guh least of all.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h4_vuur_kroni: A new Fire Lord. Fireworks. Tea.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h4_vuur_leeuw: You wake up at night on the back of an island. That island has little ears.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h4_vuur_lucht: Fly on Appa-guh through Mikai's burning airships. The team takes them down, you steer.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h4_vuur_rotsb: With Sokka-guh and Zuka to the prison in the boiling lake. Sneak past the guards and free Suki-guh.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h4_vuur_schoo: Take a seat in a Fire Nation classroom. Who is the best Fire Lord? You already know the answer, nyeg.
Zuka and Uncle Miroh. A tent, a pot of tea, and a sentence everybody has been waiting for.
The tent of the White Lotus
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h4_vuur_tonee: A play about your adventure. It's wrong from start to finish. Watch it anyway.
The Boy in the Cheese Ball
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h4_vuur_top.d: Fang flies you through the Spirit World to the Guhvatars before you. They have advice. And a few jokes.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h4_vuur_zwart: Eight minutes without fire. The throne room is empty, and deep under the palace Zuka finally says what he thinks.
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.beloning.vermomm: Fire Nation disguise (clothes for your guhs)
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.aftiteling: Go to the palace forecourt, %s: that's where the story ends.
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.agni_kai: Go to the palace forecourt, %s: Zuka and Azula-Mika are ready for the Agni Kai.
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.cel: Zuka has gone down the corridor, to the cell next to the bunker's hall, %s. Follow him.
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.dans: The secret dance party is in the cave behind the little school, %s: into the alley on the west side of the school. Inside, step onto the dance floor.
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.drakendans: The ruin of the Sun Warriors lies far to the west, %s. Walk to the foot of the long stair and climb all the way up, to the round terrace.
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.duel: Fire Lord Mikai is waiting in the duel arena among the rock pillars, %s: in the northwest, behind the ruin. Walk to the shore: the duel starts by itself.
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.eendjes: The palace pond lies in the palace garden, east of the palace, %s. Click the bread basket on the south side of the pond, by the little sign.
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.goedmaken: Stay in the team's camp, %s: Zuka wants to make up and asks you for the right words.
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.kamp: The team's camp lies west of the landing field, %s. The team is sitting by the campfire.
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.kroning: The coronation is on the palace forecourt, %s: walk through the city to the big square in front of the palace stairs.
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.miroh: Talk to Uncle Miroh in the tent of the White Lotus, %s (click him). He knows who can give you advice about the comet.
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.schildpad: Rest for a while in the camp of the White Lotus, %s. Something happens in the night...
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.school: The little school is in the city, %s: in through the crater gate and then left, in front of the palace. Walk into the classroom.
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.strand: The team is waiting on the beach next to the harbor, %s: out through the crater gate, then onto the sand east of the harbor gate, by the wooden barricades.
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.tent: The camp of the White Lotus lies far to the east, beyond the crater, %s. Go into the big tent in the middle of the camp. (Too far to walk? Climb onto Appa-guh.)
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.toneel: The open-air theater of Ember Island lies by the beach in the southwest, %s. Walk into the theater: the show starts by itself.
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.vloot: Go to the quay by the bite out of the crater rim, %s: Appa-guh comes there and you fly through the airship fleet.
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.optie.katara.doe: "Let him DO something instead of saying something."
gui.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.optie.toph.eerli: "Sorry I scorched your feet. That should never have happened."
gui.guhs.kledingbron.einde2_h4_vuur: The Legend of Guh: chapter 4 and the finale
gui.guhs.titels.hint.guhvatar: Finish the story of the Guhvatar, in the Guheinde
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.einde2_h4_vuur.re: Ba Sing Guh has fallen. Uncle Miroh has been taken. And you are still tired.
Appa-guh carries the team to the heart of the Fire Nation: a capital in a crater.
Here Fire Lord Mikai has his throne, his army and his hunger.
Disguised among the Mikas, you wait for the Day of Black Sun.
Fire is the last element. It is also the hardest. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_finale.kort.0: Fly with Fang to the Summit
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_finale.kort.4: The duel with Fire Lord Mikai
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_finale.nu.0: Talk to Uncle Miroh in his tent
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_finale.nu.0_g: Fly with Fang to the Summit of the Predecessors in the Spirit World (back in your body? Talk to Uncle Miroh again)
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_finale.nu.1: Rest for a while in the capital. Something happens in the night...
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_finale.nu.2: Fly on Appa-guh through Mikai's burning airship fleet: it starts at the quay by the bite out of the crater rim
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_finale.nu.4: Stop Fire Lord Mikai on the rock pillars, without hurting him
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_finale.nu.5: Go to the coronation on the forecourt
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_finale.nu.kla: You are the Guhvatar! Pick up a little party every day from the baker of the capital.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_finale.uitleg: The nibble comet is coming. Fire Lord Mikai wants to use its power to eat everything there is to eat, forever. The Guhvatars before you give advice, the Lion Turtle Guh teaches you something nobody knows any more, and then: the airship fleet, the Agni Kai, the duel on the rock pillars and a coronation.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_finale.waar.0: The tent of the White Lotus
Fang's Sky Path in the Spirit World
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_finale.waar.1: The capital of the Fire Nation
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_finale.waar.2: The quay at the bite out of the crater rim
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_finale.waar.4: The duel arena among the rock pillars, in the northwest behind the ruin
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_finale.waar.k: The capital of the Fire Nation
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.kort.0: Land in the capital of the Fire Nation
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.kort.10: To the theater of Ember Island
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.kort.11: To the tent of the White Lotus
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.kort.8: To the gondola of the Boiling Rock
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.nu.0: Land in the capital of the Fire Nation
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.nu.1: Go to the Fire Nation school in disguise (through the crater gate into the city, then left in front of the palace) and take a seat in class
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.nu.10: Watch the play on Ember Island: walk into the open-air theater by the beach in the southwest
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.nu.11: Find Zuka and Uncle Miroh in the big tent of the White Lotus, far to the east beyond the crater
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.nu.2: Dance at the forbidden party: stand on the square that lights up when the bar comes round
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.nu.3: Feed the turtle-duck guhs in the palace pond (click the bread basket)
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.nu.4: Go to the invasion beach, outside the crater east of the harbor gate: today the sun goes out
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.nu.5: Follow Zuka through the bunker to Uncle Miroh's cell
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.nu.6: Go back to the team's camp, west of the landing field
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.nu.7: Help Zuka make up with Toph-guh and Katara-guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.nu.7_kat: Toph-guh has come round. Now Katara-guh: help Zuka find the right words
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.nu.8: Take the gondola to the Boiling Rock (up the stone stairs to the upper station on the crater rim, east of the harbor) and free Suki-guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.nu.8_bin: Sneak across the yard to Suki-guh's cell (the little lights show the way). Crouching helps!
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.nu.9: Dance the Dancing Dragon with Zuka at the Sun Warriors: their ruin lies far to the west, climb the long stair
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.nu.klaar: Chapter 4 is done! The comet is coming. Talk to Uncle Miroh in his tent.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.stap.11: The tent of the White Lotus
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.uitleg: The capital of the Fire Nation, in the crater of a volcano of burnt cheese crust. You slip in disguised, you get to know the Fire Nation from the inside, and on the Day of Black Sun Zuka finally chooses his own path. Then: making up, learning fire from the dragons, a very bad play and a tent full of tea.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.waar.0: The landing field by the harbor
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.waar.1: The school in the crater, west of the palace
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.waar.10: The open-air theater of Ember Island
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.waar.11: The big tent in the camp of the White Lotus
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.waar.2: The dance cave, at the end of the alley next to the school
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.waar.3: The bread basket on the south side of the palace pond, in the palace garden east of the palace
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.waar.4: The beach next to the harbor, by the wooden barricades
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.waar.5: The cell next to the hall of the bunker

gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.waar.7: The camp next to the landing field

gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.waar.8_b: The Boiling Rock, the prison on the island

gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_vuur.waar.kla: The tent of the White Lotus
item.guhs.guhvatar_beeld.lore: With glowing eyes. Put it in your little house, nyeg
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.aankomst.vermo: You're in disguise! As long as you wear Fire Nation clothes, everybody thinks you're an ordinary Mika pupil. Go to the little school: through the crater gate into the city, then left in front of the palace.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.bakker.feest: Party! The war is over and the Guhvatar is in my shop! Here, on the house.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.bakker.morgen: Come back tomorrow, Guhvatar: I'll have something tasty for you again.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.bakker.spannen: Such exciting times. I just keep baking. Baking helps.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.bakker.vuurvlo: Fire flakes! Fresh! They crackle in your mouth. Two for the price of three!
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.beloning.final: You are the Guhvatar! You get your own statue, the title Guhvatar, Zuka's scar for your guhs and a big pile of nibbles.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.beloning.vuur: Chapter 4 is done! You get the Fire Nation disguise for your guhs (in the wardrobe of the Guhdex) and a bag of nibbles.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.dans.bijna: Almost! %s right, %s needed. The music simply starts again: stay on the floor and dance once more.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.dans.gewonnen: Wow! The whole cave cheers. Nobody has ever danced like that here!
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.dans.juf: Then the teacher is standing in the entrance. Everybody runs. You too: to the palace pond, where nobody looks. The turtle-duck guhs must be hungry.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.dans.start: The music starts! Every bar one square of the floor lights up: stand on it on the last beat (the bell). %s of the %s right and you win. Miss one? No matter, just keep dancing.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.dans.sub: Stand on the square that lights up!
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.dans.uitnodigi: A pupil whispers: 'Stand on the floor! When the music starts: jump onto the square that lights up!'
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.dans.weg: You step off the floor. The party goes on: come back to dance again.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.drakendans.bru: Both dragons roar! Halfway there. They're watching...
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.drakendans.gel: You can firebend! (Fire is the last element: you now know all four.)
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.drakendans.hin: Zuka's fire has grown weak. 'I have to go back to the source,' he says. The ruin of the Sun Warriors lies far to the west, beyond the camp. A long stair leads up to their terrace.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.drakendans.opn: The flames flicker... No worries: step on the tile that lights up. Slowly, and together.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.drakendans.sta: The Dancing Dragon! Step on the tile that lights up, one at a time, in a half circle. Zuka dances the other half. You have five beats per tile: no hurry.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.drakendans.sub: Step on the tile that lights up
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.drakendans.ton: The team goes to rest on Ember Island for a bit, the beach in the southwest. Tonight there's a play in the open-air theater. About... you?
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.drakendans.weg: You leave the terrace. Come back to start the dance again.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.drakendans.zon: The chief of the Sun Warriors: 'You want to understand fire? Climb the long stair. Up there you dance for the masters.'
He can't hit you any more. Mikai roars.
Every flame put out. Steam rises from the arena.
You're standing at the top. The comet is right above you.
His own fire hits him back in the face. But then...
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.duel.klaar: It's over. Go to the palace forecourt, straight ahead through the city: everybody is waiting there.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.duel.naar: Fire Lord Mikai is waiting on the rock pillars above the water. Four rounds, one for each element. Falling can't go wrong: you splash into warm water and are soon back on your pillar.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.duel.opnieuw: Hit too often (no harm done, only a shove). This round starts again.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.duel.plons: Splash! The water is lukewarm. Back on the pillar.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.duel.ronde.1: Round 1: air. Dodge his blasts. Jumping is an air jump: high and far, from pillar to pillar.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.duel.ronde.2: Round 2: water. Mikai sets four pillars on fire. Douse the flames (right-click a flame).
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.duel.ronde.3: Round 3: earth. Sparks rain down from the comet. Climb to the highest pillar (the column of light). Crouching is an earth jump: a rock column throws you up.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.duel.ronde.4: Round 4: fire. Hit his blasts back (left-click a blast that comes close).
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.duel.ronde.5: The Guhvatar State! Hit three blasts back and douse two flames. All the elements are yours.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.duel.sub.3: Climb to the column of light
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.duel.sub.5: Hit three blasts back and douse two flames
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.duel.tijd: Mikai regroups. This round starts again.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.eendjes.gevoer: Splash! The turtle-duck guhs come swimming over. They quack contentedly. One nibbles your paw gently. Out of love.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.eendjes.klik: Click the bread basket on the south side of the pond.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.eendjes.zwarte: Tomorrow is the day: the Day of Black Sun. The team gathers on the beach next to the harbor: out through the crater gate, then east of the harbor gate.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.finale.aang.1: Go and meditate! The Guhvatars before us know more than we do. Fang, Roku-guh's dragon, will fly you to the Peak of the Predecessors.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.finale.fang_wa: Fang is waiting for you at the start of his Sky Path, %s. Walk there: he'll fly you to the Summit of the Predecessors.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.finale.geen_ge: You can't meditate right now (the Spirit World isn't there). Try again later with Uncle Miroh.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.finale.meditee: You close your eyes. The White Lotus opens for you... and your spirit goes travelling.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.finale.miroh.1: Tomorrow the comet comes. Mikai will use it to eat everything there is to eat. You need advice, Guhvatar.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.finale.miroh.2: A cup of tea for the road? No? Then go with a warm heart. That's good too.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.finale.terug: You open your eyes in the tent. The tea is still warm. Outside, night falls.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.gevangenis.deu: The iron door creaks open. Someone left it ajar... Zuka?
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.gevangenis.vol: Zuka slips into the corridor, to the cell next to the hall. Follow him, quietly.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.goedmaken.kata: I don't trust him. He's betrayed us too often. Words are easy.
She's right. Guhvatar... what can I do?
Katara: 'A hug? From me? For him? No.' Try again.
Katara: '...What?' Zuka blushes up to his topknot. Try again.
Zuka makes nibble pancakes for everyone. They're burnt. Katara eats one anyway. 'Hm. Not bad. For a prince.'
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.goedmaken.sokk: Sokka-guh: 'To the gondola! It's on the crater rim, east of the harbor: up the stone stairs, the ones with the little flames.'
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.goedmaken.toph: So, Hothead. You want to say sorry. Nice. I listen with my feet, so do your best.
I... uh... Guhvatar? Help me out. What should I say?
Choose well, Guhvatar. I can feel it when he lies.
Toph stomps. Zuka flies a metre into the air. 'Warm? WARM?' Try again.
'Your honor, your honor...' Toph yawns very loudly. 'Try again, Hothead.'
Toph: 'Hm. Honest. I feel no lie. Fine, Hothead, you can sit next to me. Not too close.' Now Katara-guh...
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.daarna: The story has been told, but the world is big: the Spirit World is completely open, the baker of the capital has a treat every day, and somewhere in the Air Temple stands an empty pedestal... that isn't empty any more.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.hint.finale: The comet is coming. Uncle Miroh is waiting in the tent of the White Lotus.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.kamp.vlucht: You slip out of the bunker. The team's camp lies west of the landing field: the team is waiting there.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.miroh.komeet: The comet is coming closer. I'll make some more tea. Tea always helps a little.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.miroh.thee.0: Tea? Of course, tea. There's always tea for the Guhvatar.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.miroh.thee.1: You let a good tea steep for a while. Just like a good nephew.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.miroh.thee.2: I've filled the pot again. Sit down, nyeg. Tell me what you've been up to.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.rotsblok.betra: A guard Mika spots you! He gently shoves you back to the hall. Once more: behind his back, or crouching.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.rotsblok.binne: You're on the roof of the Boiling Rock. Sneak down and across the yard to Suki-guh's cell: the little lights show the way. Guards only see what's in front of them, and when you crouch only from very close. Spotted? No worries: you simply start again in the hall.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.rotsblok.geluk: You're out! Suki-guh is free, Sokka-guh is beaming, and Zuka belongs a little more.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.rotsblok.gonde: The gondola creaks across the boiling lake of cheese sauce...
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.rotsblok.plan: Sokka: 'There's the gondola. Get in and we'll be on the prison roof in no time. And then: sneaking. Crouch! Guards notice you less.'
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.rotsblok.sluip: Two guards walk across the yard. Stay out of their sight, or crouch.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.rotsblok.sub: Stay out of the guards' sight
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.schildpad.wakk: You're standing on the quay. Was it a dream? No: the light is still inside you. Get on Appa-guh: the airship fleet is coming!
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.toneel.daarna: The White Lotus camp lies far to the east, beyond the crater. Too far to walk? Whistle for Appa-guh.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.vloot.au: A blast of fire shoves Appa aside! (%s left)
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.vloot.botsing: Bonk! Appa-guh bumps into an airship (nobody hurt, only a dent in your pride).
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.vloot.geen_app: Appa-guh can't come right now. Try again in a moment.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.vloot.gelukt: The airship fleet is down! Everybody safe on little parachutes. Appa-guh lands by the palace...
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.vloot.geraakt: Hit too often: the fleet drives you back (the ships that are down stay down).
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.vloot.neer.sok: Sokka-guh: 'Boomerang! Always the boomerang!' The ship sinks away, smoking.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.vloot.neer.suk: Suki-guh: 'Kyoshi Warriors, forward!' The ship turns away and sinks into the clouds.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.vloot.neer.top: Toph-guh: 'Metal is earth too, nyeg!' She folds the hull in half.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.vloot.nog_niet: Too many are still flying! Taken down: %s of the %s. Turn around and help the team.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.vloot.op_appa: Off Appa-guh! You float... Appa-guh is coming to get you.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.vloot.opnieuw: Back to the start of the flight. Once more!
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.vloot.stand: Taken down: %s of the %s. Follow the little lights!
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.vloot.start: Appa-guh takes off. Ahead of you hangs Mikai's airship fleet, red and burning. Steer Appa past the ships (close, but not into them): the team jumps across and takes them down. Take down %s of the %s and follow the little lights to the column of light at the end.
quest.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur.vloot.sub: Fly past the ships, follow the little lights
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_aankomst.moe: You're still tired from Ba Sing Guh. Take it easy, okay? We'll keep an eye on you.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_aankomst.plan: Plan Disguise! Red clothes, golden trims, and nobody says the word 'Guhvatar'. Nobody. Nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_aankomst.schoe: Red? I can't see anyway. All I feel is that these shoes pinch.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_aankomst.titel: In disguise in the Fire Nation
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_aankomst.verte: The capital of the Fire Nation. A crater full of smoke, flags and lots of grumpy little flames.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_aankomst.welko: Welcome to the Fire Nation! They're said to have the tastiest fire flakes. I think. I hope.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_aftiteling.aan: Aang-guh, the previous Guhvatar (who went for a little laze)
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_aftiteling.azu: Azula-Mika, who is having a little think
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_aftiteling.ein: The story of the Guhvatar has been told. But the world is big, the tea is still warm, and there is so much left to discover. To be continued, nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_aftiteling.ied: And every guh who ever shared a nibble
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_aftiteling.kni: A guh wink to Avatar: The Last Airbender
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_aftiteling.mik: Fire Lord Mikai, full at last
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_aftiteling.muz: The music: see the credits in the Guhboek
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_aftiteling.voo: Roku-guh, Kyoshi-guh and all the Guhvatars before you
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_aftiteling.wat: Katara-guh and Sokka-guh, of the Water Tribe
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_aftiteling.wez: The Lion Turtle Guh, the dragon guhs and Fang
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_aftiteling.zuk: Fire Lord Zuka, and Uncle Miroh with his tea
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_agni_kai.agni_: An Agni Kai, little brother. A fire duel. Just you and me. On the day I become Fire Lady.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_agni_kai.dank: You jumped in front of me. Thank you, Zuka. Lie still, I'll patch you up.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_agni_kai.ga: I'm glad it's you patching me up. Go, Guhvatar! Mikai is at the rock pillars!
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_agni_kai.hou_v: Zuka! Hold on... I'm here. I'm right here.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_agni_kai.ijs: Azula sits stuck in the ice and sobs. Nobody laughs. Katara stays with her for a moment.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_agni_kai.ketti: Azula chases Katara-guh across the square. Katara lures her above a grate full of water and freezes it all at once. A chain of ice holds Azula fast.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_agni_kai.komee: The palace forecourt. The comet turns the whole sky red.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_agni_kai.niet_: I'll fight you, Azula. But you're not well. Let it go. Please.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_agni_kai.vlamm: Blue flames against red. They look alike. They are not.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_agni_kai.water: Look who's joining in. The water guh. Let's see how well you catch.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_agni_kai.zuka_: Zuka leaps in front of her. The lightning shoves him to the ground. He's breathing. He's still breathing.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_draken.cirkel: Two dragon guhs, a red one and a blue one, circle the terrace. Their little ears stand straight up.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_draken.dank: Guhvatar... thank you. For the first time my fire feels like mine. I belong now, right? With the team.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_draken.gezien: The masters have seen you. The fire in you is good. Go, and don't forget it.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_draken.jij: You feel it too: fire that doesn't burn but warms. You learn to firebend.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_draken.laatste: The last step of the Dancing Dragon. Then the terrace falls silent.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_draken.leven: Fire isn't anger... Fire is life. It's energy. It's... warm. I had forgotten that.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_draken.menu: They're going to eat us. I thought this was a dance, not a menu!
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_draken.oordeel: Now the masters judge. Show what burns in your hearts.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_draken.regenbo: They breathe fire. It doesn't burn. Red, gold, blue, green, pink: every colour of the rainbow, and a few that have no name yet.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_draken.vuur_va: Zuka is one of the team. And from now on your fire burns. It warms.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_gevangenis.dra: Uncle Miroh says nothing. He slowly turns away, to the wall.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_gevangenis.ga: ...I'm going. Take care of yourself, uncle.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_gevangenis.goe: I know I hurt you in Ba Sing Guh. I'll make it up to you. Really. Someday.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_gevangenis.nee: Uncle. I did it. I said no to father. I said what I think.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_gevangenis.opd: When Zuka is gone, Miroh does fifty push-ups. Then fifty more. Then fifty more again. The bars creak.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_gevangenis.ste: An old guh has to be strong... for when his nephew needs him again.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_gevangenis.sti: Silence. Only the tick of a drop.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kamp.avond: That evening, by the campfire. Someone is standing at the edge of the light.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kamp.eer: He spent a very long time looking for his honor. Maybe he found it. In the bin.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kamp.eruit: You? After everything you've done? Get out. Now.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kamp.eten: Zuka may stay. But nobody sits next to him at dinner.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kamp.hoi: Hello. Zuka here. I'm... on your side now. Hi.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kamp.leraar: The Guhvatar has to learn fire. Nobody else here can teach that. I can. A bit.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kamp.sorry: That was... an accident. Sorry, Toph.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kamp.tweede: Let's give it a try. Everybody deserves a second nibble.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kamp.voeten: He's telling the truth. I can feel it in his heartbeat. And in my feet. He once scorched them, you see.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kijk_dans.teks: The alley to the secret dance cave.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kijk_drakendan: The round terrace, at the top of the long stair.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kijk_eendjes.t: The bread basket by the palace pond. Click it!
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kijk_kamp.teks: The team's camp, next to the landing field.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kijk_kroning.t: The palace forecourt. Everybody is waiting for you.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kijk_school.te: The Fire Nation's little school. Take a seat in class!
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kijk_strand.te: The beach of the invasion. The team is waiting here.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kijk_suki.teks: There, across the yard: Suki-guh's cell.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kijk_tent.teks: The tent of the White Lotus. Uncle Miroh is waiting there.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kijk_toneel.te: The open-air theater. The third row is for you.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_knipoog_sjokke: He made it! Shuckly, you're a hero!
And right at the back, after four chapters: Shuckly crosses the finish line of the air scooter course.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_knipoog_stitch: WHO keeps letting that thing in?!
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kokend_rotsblo: Little brother. You look so... obedient. It doesn't suit you.
Thank you, Zuka. Sokka said you'd changed. He was right. Don't tell him.
Cut the cable! Drop them in the cheese sauce!
The gondola shoots into the station. Behind you the cable sinks groaning into the cheese sauce. Nobody falls in. Only Azula's good mood.
Yoo-hoo! Can we come too? We're coming anyway.
Suki! I knew I'd find you. I had a plan for it. Seven plans, actually.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kroning.dank: Guhvatar. You showed me who I could be. Thank you. The Fire Nation is your home too.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kroning.juiste: And you, Guhvatar... you were exactly the right guh in exactly the right place. I couldn't have passed it on to anyone better.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kroning.kroon: Uncle Miroh places the crown on his nephew's head. It fits. Of course it fits.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kroning.mooist: The best day of my life... after that time with the perfect jasmine tea.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kroning.ochten: The next morning. The forecourt is packed: Mikas, guhs, and a few puzzled turtle-duck guhs.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kroning.oom: And that from now on I'll listen to my uncle. Mostly.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kroning.plan: This is the best plan that ever worked. And I didn't even have a plan for it!
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kroning.prober: I don't promise I'll get everything right. I do promise I'll try. With the help of my friends.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kroning.theehu: I'm going to reopen the Jasmine Dragon. Drop by. There's always a cup ready for you.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kroning.voeten: I feel lots of happy feet.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kroning.voorbi: The war is over. From today we share. Every nibble, every flame, every day.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_kroning.zo: And so peace came to the four nations. With fireworks. Lots of fireworks.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_leeuwschildpad: Do not be afraid, little Guhvatar. I am older than the oldest nibble.
Go. The comet is coming. And don't forget to eat, nyeg.
You want to stop Mikai without hurting him. That is a good heart. It is also a hard heart to have.
Whoever keeps their own light strong can still the hunger of another. Take nothing from him that he needs. Give him rest.
A warm light flows through you, from your forehead to your paws. Now you know what you have to do.
You are lying on the back of an island... of a turtle... of a LION TURTLE. With little ears.
Long before the Guhvatars, guhs did not bend fire or water. They steered the light within themselves. The energy.
You wake up. It is night. The ground beneath you is breathing.
The Lion Turtle Guh slowly sinks back into the mist. The island is gone. You are standing on the quay.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_lotus_tegel.ba: After everything I did to him... will he even want to see me?
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_lotus_tegel.ga: You only find out if you go. And you're not going alone.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_lotus_tegel.me: Master Piandao-guh! You taught me swordfighting, long ago. What are you doing here?
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_lotus_tegel.na: The curtain is closed and the audience heads home. One old guh stays behind, a sword on his back.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_lotus_tegel.oo: I bring a message. Your uncle broke out of his cell on the Day of Black Sun. He twisted the bars like wet noodles.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_lotus_tegel.pr: Prince Zuka. You still hold your sword too high, I see.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_lotus_tegel.te: He's waiting for you with the White Lotus, a club of old friends. Far to the east, beyond the crater. Here: his tile.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_lotus_tegel.th: Everybody come, to the east! I hope he has tea. He's bound to have tea.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_lotus_tegel.ti: A tile of the White Lotus
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_omslag.alle: All the Guhvatars. Every one of us.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_omslag.ga: Hee-hee, me too! Go for it, nyeg!
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_omslag.laatste: The last round. All four elements. At once.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_omslag.litteke: Mikai's fire throws you against a rock pillar. A sharp point hits your back, right on the old scar of Azula's lightning.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_omslag.ogen: Your eyes glow. Air, water, earth and fire swirl around you like a ring of light. The Guhvatar State.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_plan.geheim: Azula thinks her lightning took you out in Ba Sing Guh. Everybody thinks the Guhvatar is gone. That's our secret weapon.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_plan.komeet: In a few weeks the nibble comet comes. With its power Mikai wants to eat everything there is to eat. Everything. Forever.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_plan.kring: Behind Appa-guh, on the landing field, the team sits down in a circle. The plan first. In whispers.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_plan.kuzon: A hundred years ago I had a friend here. Kuzon-guh. Not everyone in the Fire Nation is mean, really. Maybe we'll still see that.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_plan.school: Ordinary kids go to school. And that little school stands right in front of the palace: there we get to know the city, and how we get in later.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_plan.tot_dan: And until then we're ordinary Fire Nation kids. Boring, red, and we bow to every little flame.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_plan.zwarte_zo: But first comes the Day of Black Sun: eight minutes without fire. Then our fleet arrives, and you have to be there. Well rested.
There's only one way in: the gondola on the crater rim. I'm coming with you, Sokka-guh. I owe you that.
And Sokka-guh is a little bit in love. I can feel his heart thumping all the way over here.
And the Guhvatar's coming too! Three is better than two. Especially when one of the three is the Guhvatar.
Then here's the plan: the gondola to the roof, sneak across the yard, find Suki-guh, and get everybody out. The rest guard Appa-guh.
I know where they are. The Boiling Rock: a prison on an island in a lake of boiling cheese sauce. Nobody has ever escaped.
After the making up, the camp is quiet. Sokka-guh has been staring into the fire for an hour.
On the Day of Black Sun, Suki-guh held off the guards so we could get away. She and the guhs of our fleet. They were all caught.
Who is in the Boiling Rock?
Suki-guh leads the Kyoshi Warriors. They fight with fans, and they're very, very fast. She helped us once, long before we found you.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_school.beste: Good morning, class! Who knows the very best Fire Lord in all of history?
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_school.fluiste: Psst. Tonight, in the cave. Dancing is forbidden. Come!
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_school.knabbel: Very good. And who has the biggest stock of nibbles in the whole world?
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_school.opgeget: Fire Lord Mikai too, miss! Because he's eaten all the others.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_school.oren: You there, new one. Your headband is crooked. It almost looks like... little ears.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_tent.haten: I thought you would hate me.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_tent.kamp: The camp of the White Lotus. Old masters around a fire, and one tent with a light inside.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_tent.kopje: Sit down. There's another cup in the pot. And there's always one ready for you.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_tent.lot: Destiny is a funny thing, Guhvatar. Tomorrow the comet comes. Tonight we drink tea.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_tent.neefje: Hate you? You're my nephew. That doesn't stop because you take a wrong turn once. Not twice either, nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_tent.nooit: He's never going to forgive me. Why would he?
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_tent.nooit_boo: I was never angry with you. I was sad, because I was afraid you had lost your way.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_tent.opstaan: Uncle Miroh stands up. Slowly. He puts his paws around his nephew.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_tent.spijt: Uncle... I'm sorry. I was so stupid. So lost. I betrayed you, while you always... always...
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_tent.thee: Come. There is tea. There is always tea.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_tent.thee_drin: They drink tea. Not much is said. It doesn't have to be.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_tent.titel: The tent of the White Lotus
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_toneel.doek: The curtain falls. The audience claps. You clap too. A little.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_toneel.eer: My honor! My hooonor! Where is my honor?! Has anybody seen my honor?!
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_toneel.guhvata: I am the Guhvatar! I only eat vegetarian nibbles and I laugh very loudly! HAHAHAHA!
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_toneel.honger: I'm funny! I'm hungry! I'm funny because I'm hungry!
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_toneel.hoop: Hope! Hope! All I talk about is hope! And I cry a lot. Sob! Hope!
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_toneel.kant: The scar is on the wrong side. And I don't talk about my honor that often.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_toneel.lach: ...I don't laugh like that, do I? I don't laugh like that, nyeg?
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_toneel.reus: I AM A GIANT! I SEE EVERYTHING WITH MY EARS!
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_toneel.samen: You know what? The story is all wrong. But we're sitting here together. And that is completely right.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_toneel.soms: I don't only talk about... okay. Sometimes.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_toneel.tien: Finally an actor who gets me. Wonderful. Ten nibbles.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_toneel.titel: The Boy in the Cheese Ball
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_toneel.vanavon: Ember Island. Tonight the open-air theater plays 'The Boy in the Cheese Ball'. You're sitting in the third row.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_top.alleen: You're not alone in this. We are always with you, even when you can't see us. Go back to your body. It is time.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_top.geluk: A Guhvatar puts the world first. But don't forget that you belong to that world too, nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_top.hard: I never hesitated. I was sometimes too hard. Be determined, but don't let your heart harden.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_top.komeet: Tomorrow the nibble comet comes. Mikai wants to use its power to eat everything there is to eat. Everything. Forever.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_top.papier: Write everything down. Plans, lists, recipes. I had the finest desks of all the Guhvatars.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_top.top: The Peak of the Predecessors. Above the mist of the Spirit World wait the Guhvatars who came before you.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_top.twijfel: I once hesitated when I should have acted. Because of that his family could stay hungry. Don't hesitate like I did, young Guhvatar.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_top.vissen: And rest. I once fished for three days in a row. That helped too.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_trek_weg.ademt: Mikai lies on a pillar. He breathes heavily and looks at the comet. He's still hungry. Always hungry.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_trek_weg.dutje: May I... may I perhaps take a nap?
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_trek_weg.licht: Your light pushes against a dark, gnawing hunger. For a long time. Then yours wins.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_trek_weg.poten: You put one paw on his forehead and the other on his heart. Just like the Lion Turtle Guh did.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_trek_weg.snurk: He falls asleep. He snores. It sounds almost sweet.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_trek_weg.tevre: You have taken his endless appetite away. What's left is a round, content Mika who, for the first time in his life, has enough.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_trek_weg.vol: What... what have you done? I... I'm full. I'm FULL.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_vijver.eendjes: Turtle-duck guhs! Monk Guhatso and I always fed them when I was nervous. It helps. Really, nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_vijver.mand: That basket on the south side of the pond smells of bread. I can't see it, but you can. Go on, Guhvatar.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_vijver.morgen: Then let's feed them now. Tomorrow is the Day of Black Sun. Everybody's a little nervous.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_vijver.strand: Tomorrow afternoon on the beach by the harbor: that's where our fleet arrives. Eight minutes. One chance. No pressure.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_vijver.verstop: After the dance party the team slips into the palace garden. Nobody looks for runaway dancers here.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_vloot_plan.azu: And today Azula has herself crowned Fire Lady. Somebody has to stop her. That's me. Katara-guh, will you help me?
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_vloot_plan.ja: Of course. Somebody has to make sure you stay in one piece.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_vloot_plan.mik: And after that... Fire Lord Mikai. Only the Guhvatar can stop him. You can do this. We're with you.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_vloot_plan.och: The morning of the comet. The sky turns red. The whole team is already on the quay.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_vloot_plan.sch: Sokka-guh, Toph-guh and I take the ships. You steer Appa-guh, Guhvatar: as close as you can, then we jump across.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_vloot_plan.vli: Flying. On metal ships. High in the sky. My favorite metal and my worst nightmare at once, nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_vloot_plan.vlo: Bad news: Mikai's airship fleet is leaving. With the comet's power he wants to burn every nibble field in the world to nothing.
And if they don't think we're good enough?
Anger is poor fuel, prince. It burns bright, and then it's gone. The first firebenders learned it differently: from the dragons.
This is the Dancing Dragon, older than the Fire Nation itself. Two dancers, each half a circle, together one fire. Whoever dances it well sees what fire really is.
In the caves, two huge eyes open. The masters are awake: the last two dragon guhs. And they are watching. Closely.
The head of the Sun Warriors
Then they'll be disappointed. Believe me: that's worse than being eaten. Dance, Guhvatar. Dance with your heart.
At the top of the long stair lies the round terrace of the Sun Warriors. Left and right, two dark caves yawn.
Look. Ever since I chose your side, my fire is just a spark. It used to burn on anger. And that's run out.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_zwarte_zon.ach: For eight minutes no Mika can make fire. Eight minutes. That's the chance.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_zwarte_zon.ban: I'm not afraid of you any more. I'm going to help the Guhvatar. And you... you're going to learn to share.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_zwarte_zon.bli: Mikai fires a bolt of lightning. Zuka catches it, leads it through his belly, out of his arm, and sends it away: into the ceiling.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_zwarte_zon.dag: Uncle Miroh taught me that. Something you never did. Goodbye, father.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_zwarte_zon.dur: You dare. On the one day I have no fire, you come to talk.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_zwarte_zon.lee: The throne room is empty. No guards. No Fire Lord. Only the curtain of flames, gone out.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_zwarte_zon.les: The sun is back, prince. Now you get your lesson.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_zwarte_zon.lui: Father. I have something to say to you. And this time you're going to listen.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_zwarte_zon.nu: Now or never. To the palace!
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_zwarte_zon.oom: And somewhere deep under the palace, Zuka goes to the only one he still wants to see.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_zwarte_zon.pla: Everybody ready? This is it, nyeg. The plan of my life. I wrote it down three times.
I had a plan B. Plan B was actually plan A too, but quieter.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_zwarte_zon.ter: Back to the camp. All of us. We'll come back, I promise.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_zwarte_zon.val: She knew... It was a trap. Everybody back to the beach. Now!
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_zwarte_zon.weg: Zuka walks away. For the first time he doesn't look back.
You sent me away because I stood up for others. That wasn't weak. It was the best thing I ever did.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_zwarte_zon.wis: Looking for my father? How cute. We've known for weeks, little Guhvatar. He's safe, far away. And the sun will be back any moment.
scene.guhs.einde2_h4_vuur_zwarte_zon.zon: The Day of Black Sun. In the middle of the day the moon slides in front of the sun.
